data.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'arax' meaning 'little chariot' and 'celis' meaning 'heavenly', Aracelia means 'exalted one' or 'heavenly charioteer'. The name Aracelia carries the meaning “Exalted one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Aracelia usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aracelia total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
